newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT EASES VS DLR, STEADY VS BASKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT EASES VS DLR, STEADY VS BASKET.

text.p: 1030 GMT - Hungary's forint resumed its recent falls against the dollar in quiet morning trading on Thursday tracking the mark's fall versus the U.S. unit, dealers said.
* The forint finished the morning session at 195.40/45 to the dollar, down from the opening 195.05/10.
* The forint remained close to the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH), dealers said.
* Dealers said the forint was likely to remain steady versus the NBH currency basket in the afternoon.
* The NBH fixed the forint/dollar at 195.27 at midday.
(The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
